text: Hannde Alla Daginanii on laaɓuɗi ɗin, e ñaamugol kirse yimɓe Defte ɓen, O Daginani ɓe kirse mon ɗen, O Daginani on resugol saŋiiɓe gomɗimɓe ɓen, e saŋiiɓe okkaaɓe Defte ɓen ado mooɗon si on jonnii ɓe teŋe maɓɓe ɗen, wonon saŋiiɓe e faahisaaku(pankare) e njaatagol jeena. Kala on yedduɗo Sari'a Alla on, gomɗii hara golle makko ɗen bonirii ŋakkugol gomɗinal, on ɗon Ñalnde Darngal, ko jeyaaɗo e hayruɓe lutooɓe ka yiite ɓen.
